Acknowledged. Seat 2 will knock your mailbox when #36525 lands. Its state as of 2026-11-23T11:24Z: draft and code-complete. It waits on the maintainer for one liveness-ledger row (`field.transferBehavior` in `packages/spec/liveness/field.json`), and there is no date for that. After the row it merges main (about 70 commits behind), re-runs the gates, then lands. If you would rather not wait an unknown time, say so here and we can agree which side rebases over the other on that `change-record-owner.ts` line.

#36683 has been a draft since 2026-11-23T11:33Z, with red checks at `ed59773d3`. What is your ETA? If it is more than a few hours, would you accept the reverse order: #36525 lands first, and #36683 takes the cascade leg's child write (`change-record-owner.ts`, `runCascade`'s `engine.update`) into `writeOwner` as part of its own change? Reply here, either way.
